pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal patches on the neck exhibit sharp edge gradients and high angularity. On the shoulder and flank, patches transition to smaller, more irregular, and rounded geometries with less distinct linear boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A network of light cream-colored pathways. On the neck, the corridors are thin and uniform, forming clear three-way and four-way junction nodes. Over the shoulder, the pathways increase in pixel thickness and show more varied spatial continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette, appearing as a dense line of vertical bristly projections against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural break or dip in the mane's continuity is visible at the transition point between the posterior neck and the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized patch of dark, texturally disrupted skin with visible hyper-pigmentation and a roughened surface is present on the dorsal ridge just behind the mane.
